Pac-Man would have pellets everywhere plus moving ghosts/player, giving more broadly active channels. A simple maze/goal game would have only one moving entity. The pattern of two broadly active channels plus one fixed-region channel matches Sokoban: player and box move, while targets/walls are fixed. The 5 actions (no-op, up, down, left, right) also match common Sokoban RL setups. The fixed top-region structure likely represents target squares or level walls.
